name: Products.limitOrdinal
statement: Products I) : l.isGood (π C (ord I · < o)) ↔ ∃ (o' : Ordinal), o' < o ∧ l.isGood (π C (ord I · < o'))

have_tree.name: hslt
have_tree.type: Finset.sup l.val.toFinset (fun a ↦ Order.succ (ord I a)) < o

have_tree.name: hlt
have_tree.type: ∀ i ∈ l.val, ord I i < Finset.sup l.val.toFinset (fun a ↦ Order.succ (ord I a))
